headline: Record revenue and AUM lift profitability sharply
summary_short: Total revenue of $4,048M rose 17.4% y/y (+7% q/q) to a record, and diluted EPS climbed to $3.65 (+68.2% y/y), as record AUC/A ($57.9T) and AUM ($6.3T) drove positive operating leverage.
summary_long: Total revenue rose to $4,048M, up 17.4% y/y and 7% q/q, driven by higher fee revenue (management, servicing, FX trading) and net interest income on a wider margin (NIM +17bps y/y). Net income climbed to $1,084M (+56.4% y/y) as revenue growth outpaced expense growth, producing positive operating leverage and the absence of prior-year repositioning charges. Diluted EPS rose to $3.65 (+68.2% y/y), helped by a smaller diluted share count after $400M of quarterly buybacks. Cash and equivalents fell to $4,290M, down from $6,518M q/q though up 6.7% y/y; the release does not explain the sequential cash swing. No explicit numeric forward guidance was issued this quarter.

drivers.explanation: CEO cited record total revenue, record AUC/A and AUM, and a tenth consecutive quarter of positive operating leverage excluding notable items.
Company states total revenue growth was driven by higher fee revenue (management, servicing, FX trading) and higher net interest income from a wider margin.
Revenue growth outpaced 5% expense growth, and 2Q25 included repositioning and client-rescoping charges absent this quarter.
Higher net income combined with a smaller diluted share count after $400M of common-stock repurchases in the quarter.
